edges.reason: transfer() delegates to internal _transfer.
transferFrom() delegates to internal _transfer.
transferFrom() calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
approve() calls _approve with msg.sender as owner.
msg.sender is supplied as the sender argument when transfer() invokes _transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender when consuming _allowances in transferFrom.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as sender/owner for privilege and fee branches.
_transfer subtracts from and adds to _balances, affecting token accounting.
_taxFee is multiplied by amount to derive transferFee inside _transfer.
_transfer requires checkBalanceAddress(sender) for all non-privileged senders.
_transfer queries checkWhiteList(sender) before applying the fee branch.
transferFee is credited to the _marketingWallet balance inside _transfer.
_transfer compares sender with owner() to bypass fees and balance checks.
owner() reads and returns _owner.
onlyOwner on airdrop compares _msgSender() against _owner.
airdrop loops calling _basicTransfer for each recipient.
airdrop calls balanceOf(from) to validate the aggregate airdrop amount.
_basicTransfer subtracts from sender and adds to recipient in _balances.
updateTaxFee requires msg.sender to equal _marketingWallet.
updateTeamFee requires msg.sender to equal _marketingWallet.
openTrading is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender().
setCooldownEnable requires msg.sender to equal _marketingWallet.
addWhiteList requires msg.sender to equal _marketingWallet.
removeWhiteList requires msg.sender to equal _marketingWallet.
updateLPAddress requires msg.sender to equal _marketingWallet.
updateTaxFee writes the caller-supplied amount into _taxFee.
updateTeamFee writes the caller-supplied fee into _teamFee.
setCooldownEnable overwrites _maxTxAmount with the current _teamFee.
setCooldownEnable reads _teamFee as the new transfer limit.
addWhiteList pushes botAdd into the _whiteList array.
removeWhiteList pushes newAdd into the _newList blacklist array.
updateLPAddress overwrites _lpAddress, altering which sender bypasses checks.
checkBalanceAddress invokes checkBlackList on the wallet address.
checkBalanceAddress calls balanceOf(_walletAddress) twice for threshold comparisons.
checkBalanceAddress compares the wallet against _lpAddress.
checkBalanceAddress compares the wallet balance with _maxTxAmount.
checkBalanceAddress computes _botBalance as _tTotal * 30 / 100.
_marketingWallet is initialized from _msgSender(), granting the deployer fee collection and admin privileges.
_lpAddress is initialized from _msgSender(), granting check bypass privileges.
constructor uses _msgSender() as the initial supply holder.
constructor credits _tTotal to _balances[msg.sender].
constructor reads _tTotal when minting the initial supply.
checkWhiteList iterates the _whiteList array comparing entries.
checkBlackList iterates the _newList array comparing entries.
transferFrom subtracts amount from _allowances[sender][msg.sender].
sendValue forwards the full gas stipend to an arbitrary recipient via a low-level call, enabling reentrant callbacks after balance checks.
_functionCallWithValue executes caller-supplied calldata on an external target, allowing arbitrary callbacks into other contracts.
_functionCallWithValue asserts isContract(target) before performing the low-level call.
isContract assigns extcodehash(account) into the codehash local and compares it with known hashes.
sender parameter is consumed by the balance and privilege checks in _transfer.
recipient parameter receives the credited balance in _transfer.
amount parameter drives the fee and balance arithmetic in _transfer.
transferFee local is derived inside _transfer and credited to the marketing wallet.
transferAmount local is derived inside _transfer and credited to the recipient.
transferFee = amount.mul(_taxFee).div(100).
transferAmount = amount.sub(transferFee).
from parameter is the source account debited by airdrop.
addresses array is iterated by airdrop to select recipients.
tokens array is summed and individually transferred by airdrop.
SCCC accumulates the looped token amounts before the balanceOf(from) check.
amount parameter is written into _taxFee by updateTaxFee.
newFee parameter is written into _teamFee by updateTeamFee.
botAdd parameter is pushed into _whiteList by addWhiteList.
newAdd parameter is pushed into _newList by removeWhiteList.
addr parameter is assigned to _lpAddress by updateLPAddress.
spender parameter is forwarded from approve into _approve.
